name: Omoikkiri! Seieki Tairyou Chuunyuu!  ~Takabisha Onna o Aherasero!~
original_name: 思いっきり! 精液大量注入! ～高飛車女をアヘらせろ!～
source:
The lead character has no ability to read the situation and is bullied by several female classmates.
But one day, he happens to find a magical drug which makes him an absolute stud!
After ejaculating an incredible amount of sperm, he starts thinking about the revenge using this ability...

[From [url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE065363.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
主角没有读懂局势的能力，被几个女同学欺负。
但有一天，他碰巧发现了一种神奇的药物，这让他成为了绝对的种马！
在射出大量精子后，他开始考虑利用这种能力进行复仇……
